content: Bab-Dummadse-goled-neg-sunna-selegedga ibmar-ukleged
Bab-Jehová Moisésʼga sunmakded, ega sogded:
“Israel-dulemarga be sogo, anga-ibmar-ukega be ibmar weemaloye. Bela na e-ulubgi-ibmar-ukbi-itogedba, na ukmaloye.
We-ibmarmar-uklegoed be abingaoed:
”A-abargine an gudii guoed.
Ar igi bela an bega oyogoe, a-sunnagwad be dulemar-anse-goled-neg-sunna-seleged be soboed, degi, a-yagi bela ibmar-ebuleged a-sunnagwad be sobbaloed.”
Bab-Dummad-Dulemarbo-Igar-Mesisad-Ulu-soblegoed
“Deginbali, ulu be sobbaloed.

content.text: degi, ulu-asgine, olo-sunnabi ebiris egi be nasikbaloed.
Deginbali, birgi, bela-ebiris e-mullugwad olobi be nasikbaloed.

content: ”Agala, olua-dummagan-gwabake-sobega or be duoed. Ulu-e-dikar-bergunaid-sogbakegwadgi gwa-gwagwen be nasikoed.
”Urgo-acaciaʼye-nugad-walagana suitii be soboed. We-suarmargi or egi bela be nasikoed.
Suarmar-walagana-suid, ulugi-olua-dummagan-nanaid-yaba be odogoed, adi, a-suarmargi ulu nabir selegegar.
Suarmar-walagana-suigan, ulu-e-olua-dummagan-nanaid-yaba-dogar-mai degisadegudoed, bar be ungosulid.
A-uluyagi Igar-narmakar-an-bega-ukoedi be mesoed.

”Degine, baliwiturmar-dummagan-querubinʼye-nugmalad-walabo orbi be sobbaloed. Be soboedi, mardogi-binna-binna-sarsoar-sobnai be imakoed. Baliwiturmar-querubinʼmar-warbogwad ulu-eduged-birgi e-duku-dukusik-gwichi be soboed.
Degisoggu, querubin-wargwen ulu-eduged-birgi e-dukusik be soboed, degi, baid-querubin-wargwen e-duku-baidsik be sobbaloed. Ulu-edugedba-mesa be querubin-warbogwad soboed.
”Geb a-sorbali, ulu-edugedi, ulu-birgi be mesoed, geb ulu-yagi dulemar-ebo-an-Igar-Mesnaid narmakar-an-bega-ukoedi be mesoed.
An besega, querubinʼmar-warbogwad-gwichid-abargi, ulu-eduged-birgi, magarogoed. Agi an bebo sunmakoed. Agi an bega-Israel-dulemarga-ibmar-sogoed, an bela bega sogoed.”
Bab-Dummadga-madu-ukleged-mese-soblegoed
“Deginbali, mese be soboed. Urgo-acaciaʼye-nugad be ebugoed.
”Olobi egi be nasikoed, degi, e-dikar-bela-ebilis olo mulluu be mesoed.
Deginbali, e-dikar-bela-ebilis wis-nibakwaa be imakbaloed. E-matardungued, argan-matagwen be imakoed. We-wis-nibakwaa-be-imakoedgi, or ebiris be nasikoed.
”Deginbali, oluaduk-dummagan, gwabake be soboed. Mese-e-nag-sogbakegwad-iliba gwa-gwagwen be nasikoed.
Oluaduk-dummagan-gwabakegwad, mesegi-mulluu-mesilesad-urba nai guoed. A-oluaduk-dummagan-yaba suar-suid dogoed, adi, mese nabir semalagar.
”Suar-acaciaʼye-nugad-walagana suitii be soboed. A-suar-walagana-ebilis or be matak-matak nasikoed, degi, a-suar-walaganagi mese be semaloed.
”E-bormomar be sobbaloed, adi, agi Bab-Dummadga-ibmar-uknaid eogegar. Wemala olo-nuedbi be imakoed.
Madu-Bab-Dummad-asabin-ukleged, mese-birgi-maigu be imakoed.”
Gwallu-sied olobi soblegoed
“Deginbali, gwallu-sied olobi be soboed.
”Gwallu-siedgi, e-sakwa walanergwa-nika (6) be imakoed.

content.text: Degine, e-sakwa-baidgi nur-matargana-e-dutuyob nog be sobbaloed,
e-abingaedmar, degi, e-dutumar egi be sobbaloed.
E-abingaedmala, degi, e-sakwamala, unnila bela gwennaa be imakoed.
Geb degine, ega gwallu gwagugle (7) be soboed.
A-gwallumala be ogaoed, adi, asabin neg-mee imakegar.
Gwallu-sied be sobegala, degi, bela e-ibmar-burwigana-sobegala,

content: ”Nue be dako, be imakoedi, igi yar-birgi bega e-dakleged oyolesa, a-sunnagwad be imakoed.”
